name: On-chain Forensics
description: Decision-first on-chain forensics. Ask whether a token or wallet is worth touching and get a graded, measured answer instead of raw data: activity score 0-100, letter grade A-F, risk flags and a reason. Reads are made on a private node, data_quality never turns an unreadable chain into a zero, and no LLM sits in the decision path. Payable per call in USDC over x402 on Base (eip155:8453); free tier available with a developer key.

x402.description: HTTP 402 payment in USDC on Base. Each call is priced individually; a free developer key is available for evaluation.

skills.name: Token verdict
skills.description: Is this token alive and how risky is it? Returns grade (A-F), score 0-100, risk flags and a one-line roast, from transfer and distinct-wallet activity in the recent window.
examples: Grade this token before I buy

skills.name: Wallet verdict
skills.description: Does this wallet actually hold what it claims? Returns real holdings, dormancy and concentration rather than a raw balance scrape.
examples: What is really in this wallet?

skills.name: Settlement safety check
skills.description: Can this asset settle a payment? Checks ERC-20 readability, canonical versus counterfeit contract, and decimals before money moves.
examples: Is this token safe to accept as payment?

skills.name: Token or wallet memo
skills.description: Composed due-diligence answer for one token or wallet: supply, activity, asset verification, who is minting, concentration, and a bottom line. States PARTIAL explicitly when a read is incomplete.
examples: Write me a due-diligence memo on this token

skills.name: Portfolio sweep
skills.description: Portfolio-level sweep: real holdings, dormant dust, and what is worth ignoring. Never returns an empty portfolio when the read failed.
examples: Sweep this wallet and tell me what matters

skills.name: Batch token screen
skills.description: Screen 25 to 500 tokens at once from cache. Ladder: 25 for $1, 100 for $3, 250 for $6, 500 for $10.
examples: Screen these 200 tokens for dead or thin activity

skills.name: Graded token directory
skills.description: Free browsable directory of 500 graded tokens across Ethereum and Base, one page per token with grade, rank and percentile against the chain median.
examples: Which Base tokens are graded F?

skills.name: Embeddable grade badge
skills.description: Free SVG badge returning the grade for any contract, cached, no key, degrades to NOT GRADED instead of a broken image.
examples: Give me a badge for this contract
